data.name: LACUNA -ZEROA-
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Every world you've ever dreamed of. One battlefield.
LACUNA -ZEROA- is an open world survival craft FPS set in a world shaped by colliding civilizations — ancient Gothic ruins, abandoned sci-fi military outposts, and mythical landscapes inspired by dark fantasy and JRPG worlds. Every region tells a different story.

Five Elements. Infinite Tactics.

Choose from five elemental attributes — Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, and Earth. Your element shapes how you fight. Enchant any weapon with elemental power — load Thunder Rounds into your assault rifle, coat your scythe in ice, or set your shotgun shells ablaze. Every weapon in your arsenal becomes an extension of your element.

Unleash powerful elemental abilities in combat. Raise an Ice Wall to block enemy fire. Execute a Shock Dash to close the distance in a flash. Combine your enchanted weapons with your abilities to create devastating combat strategies unique to your playstyle.

An Arsenal of Weapons

LACUNA -ZEROA- features a wide variety of weapons — from firearms like assault rifles and revolvers to melee weapons like swords, greatswords, and scythes. Every weapon can be enchanted with your element, giving each one a distinct identity on the battlefield.

Fast, Fluid Combat

Experience aggressive first-person combat with fast movement mechanics. Sprint, slide, wall-climb, and mantle through a vertical world built for dynamic engagements. No stamina bars slowing you down — LACUNA -ZEROA- rewards relentless aggression and creative movement.

Survive Together or Alone

Scavenge resources from ancient ruins and fallen enemies. Craft weapons, armor, and elemental consumables to gain an edge. Manage your food, water, and health as you push deeper into hostile territory. Play solo and carve your own path, or team up with other players to dominate the battlefield. Trust no one — or build an empire together.

PvP and PvE

Battle other players for territory and resources in open world PvP. Hunt dangerous creatures and powerful bosses lurking in the darkest corners of the map. Whether you seek conflict with other survivors or challenge the world itself, LACUNA -ZEROA- delivers both.

A World of Many Inspirations

Explore a vast open world where every region draws from a different vision. Frozen Gothic cathedrals. Overgrown JRPG-inspired fantasy forests. Abandoned near-future military installations. Sci-fi research facilities buried underground. Each area has its own atmosphere, loot, and dangers — rewarding those who dare to explore.

Key Features

  • Five Elemental Attributes — Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, and Earth

  • Weapon Enchanting — enchant any weapon, from firearms to melee, with elemental power

  • Elemental Abilities — powerful skills that reshape the flow of combat

  • Diverse Weapon Arsenal — assault rifles, revolvers, swords, greatswords, scythes, and more

  • No Stamina System — fast, unrestricted movement with sprint, slide, wall-climb, and mantle

  • Open World Survival Craft — gather, craft, build, and survive

  • Solo or Team Play — survive alone or form teams with other players

  • PvP and PvE — fight players and hunt dangerous creatures

  • A World of Contrasts — dark fantasy, sci-fi, military, and JRPG-inspired environments built in Unreal Engine 5

data.short_description: LACUNA -ZEROA- is a Fantasy Military Open World Survival Craft FPS. Wield elemental powers, enchant weapons from assault rifles to scythes, and fight to survive in a world where dark fantasy, sci-fi, and military aesthetics collide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-12900K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 / AMD RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains realistic depictions of violence and blood during combat and exploration within its open-world environment. Players may encounter intense battle scenes and the aftermath of conflict as part of the core gameplay experience. There are no depictions of sexual violence, non-consensual sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
